Class LinkedSet<T>

  • java.lang.Object
    • LinkedSet<T>
  • Type Parameters:
    T - the type of elements maintained by this set
    All Implemented Interfaces:
    java.lang.Iterable<T>, java.util.Collection<T>, java.util.Set<T>
    public class LinkedSet<T>
extends java.lang.Object
implements java.util.Set<T>
    A custom implementation of the Set interface based on a singly linked list.

    This implementation does not allow duplicate elements and does not maintain any particular order of elements. It provides basic set operations such as adding, removing, checking containment, and iteration.

      • iterator

        public java.util.Iterator<T> iterator()
        Returns an iterator over the elements in this set.

        The iterator does not support modification of the set during iteration. If the set is modified while iterating, a ConcurrentModificationException is thrown.
